profiles.name: UK mainstream
profiles.description: The default. Insect colourants are excluded, topical ethanol from a non-khamr source is treated as doubtful rather than prohibited, and wool and bee products are permitted.

profiles.name: JAKIM / MS 2634
profiles.description: Follows the Malaysian halal cosmetics standard, which permits non-intoxicating alcohol in cosmetics but requires documented halal sourcing for animal-derived material.

profiles.name: BPJPH / MUI
profiles.description: Indonesian regulator position. Ethanol is acceptable when not derived from the intoxicating-liquor industry, and water-impermeable cosmetics are permitted but must be removed before ablution.

profiles.name: Strict
profiles.description: Avoids all ambiguity. Any ethanol, any insect derivative and any undocumented animal route is treated as disqualifying.

profiles.name: Istihalah-permissive
profiles.description: Accepts the transformation argument, so chemically transformed derivatives and weathered animal secretions are treated as permissible.
